attrs.title: KPSS test for trend stationarity of index_y
attrs.label: KPSS statistic (H0: stationarity)
notes: Critical values: Kwiatkowski et al. (1992, Table 1); the p-value is interpolated between them and bounded to [0.01, 0.10].
The p-value is below 0.01 (the statistic is above the 1% point).
